notes: The italic and* is added because no conjunction morpheme stands in the Hebrew clause (rule 14's closing sentence), while the italic of* is the bare nominal קָרְבָּנוֹ's own supplied preposition under rule 33.
תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ is split as is able for יָד, to get for the verb and he for the suffix; treating the whole idiom as one noncompositional unit was the competing reading.
that which goes whole to the written אֲשֶׁר under rule 46's first rider, headed on which, the word directly realizing the relative.
